authority: Explicit in-session operator decision (2026-07-27): 'Resolve to upstream + log'. Git-hygiene repair of committed merge-conflict corruption plus a §12.3 contradiction resolution record. NOT a constitutional amendment.
ticket: DOD-1 (plans/tickets_phase8_review.md ticket 8), criterion 1 — 'Tier-4 phase/gate state is mirrored into the vault's phase-gate-state folder by the projector and validates against the graph schema.' Building that mirror surfaced pre-existing corruption in the phase 1-3 gate-result artifacts the projector must read.
trigger: Seven durable Tier-4 artifacts under docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase{1,2,3}_* carried committed git merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<< Updated upstream / ======= / >>>>>>> Stashed changes), introduced by commit bffe89d ('fixed branch drift', 2026-07-22). The corruption was previously observed and deliberately left untouched by ST-1 (st-1-content-based-staleness_2026-07-27.json 'verification'), which fixed a mechanism with fixtures and correctly refused to fabricate freshness for it. The docs->graph projector (runner/graph_projector.py) reads every *.json under phase_outputs to build the phase_gate_state mirror; the conflict-markered files are not valid JSON, so json.loads raised and the scan SILENTLY dropped them, mirroring 9 of 13 gates while reporting success — an incomplete mirror indistinguishable from a complete one.
contradiction_analysis_12_3: The seven files split into two classes, and the contradiction is narrower in one than the other. (1) The FOUR gate-result files (phase1 gate_result.json + gate_01_result.json, phase2 gate_result.json, phase3 gate_result.json) contradict in PROVENANCE ONLY: 'status': 'pass' lies OUTSIDE the conflict markers in every one (both sides agree the gate passed), and the marked regions differ only in run_id, input_fingerprint, input_artifact_fingerprints, and evaluated_at. (2) The THREE summary files (call_analysis_summary.json, concept_refinement_summary.json, wp_structure.json) contradict in their WHOLE SUBSTANTIVE BODY, not just provenance: the 'Updated upstream' side is the coherent MSCA-PF payload (e.g. resolved_instrument_type 'MSCA-PF', evaluation weights 0.5/0.3, source ef_he-msca_en.pdf) while the 'Stashed changes' side is orphaned RIA/MAESTRO state (resolved_instrument_type 'RIA', weights null, source ef_he-ria-ia_en.pdf) — a whole-artifact divergence. In BOTH classes the 'Updated upstream' side carries the msca-pf-real-01 lineage and the 'Stashed changes' side is the stale UUID runs (ec190493-.../c084e3dd-.../cb3ad20d-...) with 2026-04-21 evaluated_at timestamps (three months older than upstream's 2026-07-16). Because the summary bodies diverge wholesale, the decision to keep upstream is the choice of the coherent MSCA-PF lineage over orphaned April RIA state — it is NOT a provenance-only pick for those three; the direction is the same and correct for all seven (upstream = the graph run's actual bootstrap lineage), but the magnitude of what is discarded differs by class.

decision.D1_keep_upstream: Resolve every conflict to the 'Updated upstream' (msca-pf-real-01) side, discarding the 'Stashed changes' UUID-run side. Rationale: msca-pf-real-01 is the exact prior run the graph-sourced run (msca-pf-graph-01) bootstrapped phases 1-7 from — confirmed by .claude/runs/msca-pf-graph-01/run_manifest.json accepted_upstream_gates, whose phase_01_gate / phase_02_gate / gate_09 entries all record original_run_id 'msca-pf-real-01'. Keeping upstream makes the durable gate-result run_id agree with the continuation record the checkpoint publisher (CHK-1) and bootstrap freshness (ST-1) consult. The stashed UUID side is orphaned April state with no live run lineage.
decision.D2_no_fabrication: The resolution is a pure deletion of the conflict markers and the stashed side — no field value was invented, edited, or recomputed. Each resolved file was validated as parseable JSON with an unchanged 'status': 'pass'. This is git-hygiene repair of a mechanical merge accident, NOT a re-evaluation of any gate (CLAUDE.md §12.4 / §13.3 preserved: no gate outcome was manufactured).
decision.D3_projector_hardens_regardless: Independent of the data repair, the projector is hardened so this class of corruption can never again be silently absorbed: scan_tier4_gate_states now returns a Tier4Scan{gate_states, unreadable}, recording every *.json it cannot parse as a gate result; project() carries unreadable through to ProjectionResult and the CLI prints 'unreadable=N' on stdout and names each corrupt file on stderr (§12.4 — an incomplete mirror must be visible). Rendered mirror nodes are additionally validated against runner/graph_schema.validate_front_matter, failing closed (GraphProjectionError) on any schema-invalid node — making schema-validity an enforced invariant, not an implicit property.

verification: After resolution: grep for conflict markers under phase_outputs/ returns clean (0 files). The projector re-run reports 'mirrored=13 pruned=0 unreadable=0' (was 9 mirrored with 4 gate results silently dropped: phase1 gate_01_result + phase1 gate_result + phase2 gate_result + phase3 gate_result). All 13 rendered PGS-*.md mirror nodes validate against the generic graph schema (validate_front_matter: 13 valid, 0 invalid), and read_vault parses the vault without error. The mirror nodes themselves are gitignored (**/18_phase_gate_state/PGS-*.md) — a derived, regenerable Tier-4 mirror (§9.2), so the durable commit carries the projector hardening + tests + the resolved source artifacts, not the generated mirror.
no_constitutional_amendment_rationale: Repairing committed merge-conflict corruption and hardening a downstream read is not a constitutional change: no phase meaning, tier meaning, gate condition, or authority-hierarchy rule is altered. §12.3 (contradictions between states resolved explicitly, recording the side that prevailed and the reasoning) is satisfied by this entry. §13.11 (no modifying Tier 1/2 source to reflect project assumptions) is not implicated — these are Tier-4 run-state artifacts, and the edit removes accidental corruption rather than injecting assumptions. Recorded here per §9.4 / §12.3 so a future reader knows why the phase 1-3 gate results carry the msca-pf-real-01 lineage and not the orphaned April UUID runs.
